newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pasminco says has undrawn credit for Century.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pasminco says has undrawn credit for Century.

text.p: Australian miner Pasminco Ltd said on Thursday it would be able to use undrawn credit lines to fund the purchase of Century Zinc Ltd for A$345 million from the RTZ-CRA group.
"We are in a position to fund the purchase price from undrawn credit lines," Pasminco managing director David Stewart told a news briefing.
Pasminco has already made a A$10 million payment.
Stewart said ayment of the remaining A$335 million depended on the successful outcome of talks with indigenous groups over land claims to the mine site and outlying areas.
He said that if the talks succeeded, Pasminco would then be faced with an expense of up to A$1 billion to develop the mine, which would be funded from a mix of debt and equity .
"We have to fund the development of the mine, which is up to another A$1 billion, so clearly that will require a mix of debt and equity." Stewart said.
A go-ahead to develop the mine would lift Pasminco's gearing to between 35 percent and 40 percent from the current 25, Stewart said.
"Thirty-five to 40 percent is what we'd like on this... That's about a prudent level of gearing," he said.
Gearing is the ratio of a company's total debt to its equity.
